Two bedroom semi detached cottage in tucked away location

This two bedroom cottage is modern yet full of character and is located down a quiet cul de sac just off Harleston High Street. The property has been well looked after and is perfect for an owner occupier or someone looking for an investment property. On the ground floor the property comprises a living room and a kitchen/dining room. There are two bedrooms and a bathroom off a landing on the first floor. Outside to the front of the property there is a garden and outbuilding, currently used as storage and utility area.
